## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `security` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:access` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-form`'s non-default `ObjectForm` arms: `TabbedForm`, `WizardForm` and `SplitForm` never call `applyFieldPermissions` (`fieldWriteGate.ts`), and no arm but the default calls `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances` (the ADR-0092 D4 managed-object lock, objectui#10613, folded here) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: under the same principal, three arms draw a field the user may not read, and five arms draw editable inputs on a managed object, so the arms disagree with each other. Both halves are defence in depth: ObjectStack's `FieldMasker` strips the denied field, and the server write guard refuses the managed write. That is the objectui#10434 family (p3). One family, one seam: objectui#10613 closes into this card under the closure rule (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110), and both halves come from the same probe.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T13:52Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10613 and both threads, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: one field-gate step that every arm goes through (the FLS drop and lock, plus the managed-object lock), not three more per-arm copies. PR objectui#10556 (merged) routes the default arm through the shared section builder, which is the natural seam. Pin the six arms × (a read-denied field, a managed object with no `userActions.create`) drawing the same field set and the same disabled state. The write-set sibling objectui#10563 is closed.

Status note for the next claimant, from the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`). ⛔ No label, grade, assignee or scope change.

**The FLS draw half of this card landed with PR objectui#10626** (objectui#10563, merged as `e0f820246`). Its commit `4c2bf0c9f` runs each of `TabbedForm`, `SplitForm` and `WizardForm`'s resolved section fields through `applyFieldPermissions`. It is pinned per route in `packages/plugin-form/src/formArmsWritePayload-10563.test.tsx` (the render rows), with an ablation leg. Read on objectui `main` in this act: all six arms (`ObjectForm.tsx`, `DrawerForm.tsx`, `ModalForm.tsx`, `TabbedForm.tsx`, `SplitForm.tsx`, `WizardForm.tsx`) now call `applyFieldPermissions`.

**Still open here:** the managed-object lock folded in from objectui#10613. `resolveEffectiveCrudAffordances` is still called only by the default arm (`ObjectForm.tsx`), so five arms draw editable inputs on a managed object. The triage's execution note (「one field-gate step that every arm goes through … not three more per-arm copies」) still applies, and the six-arm × (read-denied field, managed object) pin should include the FLS rows so both halves are held by one table.

- Reviewer, pre-existing: a form with no `mode` is never locked, although `mode` is a required key in `@object-ui/types` ⇒ noted, not authorable metadata.
